name: 05-roma
reading:
Mixed reactions: Allegri furious, Gasperini cautious, some see Roma's win.

Yahoo Sports reported that Allegri was enraged after the 3-3 draw with Napoli, stating, 'Maybe I shouldn't be on the touchline,' while also noting Roma's comeback in a broader context. ESPN Singapore's Burley expressed uncertainty regarding the match quality, asking if Manchester United were good or Roma were bad. Conversely, Gasperini indicated that Roma feel like they dropped two points in the Napoli draw, though he also highlighted that scoring many goals is a good signal. Hooligan Soccer offered an opinion piece framing the result as a 'Roma Gift' rather than a Manchester United win.
